# simplelogin_alias (Data Source)

Reads an existing SimpleLogin alias by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplelogin_alias" "admin" {
  id = "12345"
}

output "admin_alias_enabled" {
  value = data.simplelogin_alias.admin.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) SimpleLogin alias ID.

### Read-Only

- `creation_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `email` (String) Alias address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alias forwards mail.
- `mailbox_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the mailboxes the alias forwards to.
- `name` (String) Alias display name, or null.
- `note` (String) Alias note, or null.
